changes.old: Unlike thermal foggers, the Cold fogger machine with 2 stoke engine- 100XMCF42  cold fogger generates ultra-fine droplets through air-shear atomisation at ambient temperature. No open combustion. No hot surfaces. No fuel vapour. This makes it safe for use in occupied hospitals, schools, food processing facilities, and server rooms where thermal fog cannot be deployed. The same WHO-approved chemicals deliver the same efficacy — without the heat risk.

changes.old: The Double Barrel Thermal Fogging Machine | Vehicle Mountable vehicle-mounted system allows municipal teams to cover entire wards — thousands of residents — in a single morning fogging drive. The dual-barrel configuration delivers up to 100 litres of insecticide fog per hour, while the 100-litre chemical tank means fewer stops for refilling. Mounted on a erikshaw or pickup truck , one machine and two operators can achieve what would require 6–8 portable machines.
